chapterInfo.content:
11
Nkuro mufoɔ ne nkuraasefoɔ
1 # Neh 7.5 Na ɔman no akannifoɔ no te Yerusalem; na ɔman no nkaeɛ twee ntonto sɛ wɔde nnipa du mu baako bɛtena Yerusalem, kuro kronkron no mu, na baakron atenatena nkuro mu. 2Na ɔman no hyiraa mmarima a wɔyii wɔn yam sɛ wɔrebɛtena Yerusalem no nyinaa.
3 # 1 Be 9.2-17; Neh 7.57 Na ɔmantam no so atitire a wɔtenaa Yerusalem no nie: Nso Yuda nkuro no mu deɛ, wɔn nyinaa tenatenaa wɔn agyapadeɛ so wɔ wɔn nkuro mu. Israel yɛ asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ ne nsɔfokwaa ne Salomo nkoa mma no. 4Na Yerusalem deɛ, Yuda mma no bi ne Benyamin mma no bi tenaa hɔ. Yuda mma no mu: Usia ba Ataia, Sakaria ba, Amaria ba, Sefatia ba, Mahalalel ba a ɔfiri Peres mma no mu. 5Ne Baruk ba Maaseia, Kol-hose ba, Hasaia ba, Adaia ba, Yoiarib ba, Sakaria ba, Siloni ba. 6Peres mma a wɔtenaa Yerusalem nyinaa yɛ ahanan aduosia nwɔtwe, mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho.
7Na Benyamin mma nie: Mesulam ba Salu, Yoed ba, Pedaia ba, Kolaia ba, Maaseia ba, Itiel ba, Yesaia ba; 8na n’akyiri no: Gabai, Salai: Ahankron aduonu nwɔtwe. 9Na Sikri ba Yoel ne wɔn so hwɛfoɔ; na Senua ba Yuda di kuro no fa a ɛtɔ so mmienu no so.
10Asɔfoɔ mu: Yoiarib ba Yedaia, Yakin; 11Hilkia ba Seraia, Mesulam ba, Sadok ba, Meraiot ba, Ahitub ba a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn fie panin; 12ne wɔn nuanom a wɔyɛ efie no mu adwuma no, ahanwɔtwe aduonu mmienu; ne Yeroham ba Adaia, Pelalia ba, Amsi ba, Sakaria ba, Pasur ba, Malkia ba, 13ne ne nuanom, agyanom so atitire, ahanu aduanan mmienu. Ne Asarel ba Amasai, Ahsai ba, Mesilemot ba, Imer ba, 14ne wɔn nuanom, mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho: Ɔha aduonu nwɔtwe; na wɔn so hwɛfoɔ ne Hagedolim ba Sabdiel.
15Lewifoɔ mu nso: Hasub ba Semaia, Asrikam ba, Hasabia ba, Buni ba 16ne Sabetai ne Yosabad, wɔdi Nyankopɔn fie anihumafoɔ so, wɔfiri Lewifoɔ atitire no mu; 17ne Mika ba Matania, Sabdi ba, Asaf ba, otitire a ɔfiri aseda dwom ase mpaebɔ mu, ne Bakbukia a ɔdi hɔ ne nuanom mu, ne Samua ba Abda, Galal ba, Yedutun ba. 18Lewifoɔ a wɔwɔ kuro kronkron no mu no nyinaa ano si ahanu aduɔwɔtwe nnan.
19Na apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no: Akub, Talmon ne wɔn nuanom a wɔwɛn apono ano no: Ɔha aduɔson mmienu. 20Na Israel nkaeɛ no, asɔfoɔ no, Lewifoɔ no wɔ Yuda nkuro mu tete wɔn agyapadeɛ so. 21Na nsɔfokwaa no tenaa Ofel. Na Siha ne Gispa di nsɔfokwaa no so.
22Na Lewifoɔ a na wɔte Yerusalem no so hwɛfoɔ ne Bani ba Usi, Hasabia ba, Matania ba, Mika ba, Asaf mma no mu nnwontofoɔ wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn fie adwuma no. 23Na ɔhene mmara nsɛm wɔ wɔn ho, na wɔahyɛ kyɛfa bi ama nnwontofoɔ no, da biara ne ne deɛ. 24Na Mesesabel ba Petahia a ɔfiri Yuda ba Sera mma mu no hyɛ ɔhene ase ɔman no ho asɛm nyinaa mu.
Nkuraa a ɛwɔ Yerusalem akyi
25 # Yos 20.7; 21.11 Na wɔn adɔsase so nkuraa no deɛ, Yudafoɔ no mu bi tenatenaa Kiriat-arba ne ɛho nkurowa mu, ne Dibon ne ɛho nkurowa mu, ne Yekabseel ne ɛho nkuraa mu, 26ne Yesua ne Molada ne Bet-pelet, 27ne Hasar-sual ne Beer-seba ne ɛho nkurowa mu, 28#Yos 15.31 ne Siklag ne Mekona ne ɛho nkurowa mu, 29ne En-rimon, ne Sora, ne Yarmut, 30Sanoa, Adulam ne wɔn nkuraa mu, Lakis ne ɛho mfofowa so, Aseka ne ɛho nkurowa mu, na wɔtenatenaa firi Beer-seba kɔsii Hinom bonhwa mu. 31#Yos 18.22 Na Benyamin mma a wɔfiri Geba no tenaa Mikmas ne Aia ne Betel ne ɛho nkurowa mu, 32Anatot, Nob, Anania, 33Hasor, Rama, Gitaim, 34Hadid, Seboim, Nebalat, 35Lod ne Ono, adwumfoɔ tenaa bonhwa mu. 36Na Lewifoɔ no mu nkyekyɛmu a wɔyɛ Yuda deɛ no bi fraa Benyamin mu.

Lewifoɔ a wɔwɔ kuro kronkron no mu no nyinaa ano si ahanu aduɔwɔtwe nnan.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
